question: When do we get paid?
expectedFacts: Pay is direct deposited on the 15th of each month for the prior month's hours
If the 15th is a weekend or bank holiday, pay arrives one business day earlier

expectedFacts: Client billing employees enter hours weekly in QuickBooks or their Operating Company timekeeping system
Hours are due by 5pm Friday

question: Which holidays does Ingage observe?
expectedFacts: Salaried employees get eight paid holidays
They include New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, the day after Thanksgiving or a floating holiday, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day

question: What does the Employee Assistance Program actually offer?
expectedFacts: The EAP is provided through Principle and is free and confidential for employees and their families
It offers counseling, legal and financial guidance, and stress/life-transition resources

question: I hurt myself at work, who do I report it to?

In an emergency, go to the nearest hospital emergency room

Basic Responsibilities and Duties of all Employees

question: What happens if someone misses three days in a row without approval?
expectedFacts: Being absent three consecutive scheduled workdays without approval is treated as a voluntary resignation
expectedSections: Discipline & Leaving Revision Collective and its Operating Companies

question: Am I allowed to keep my handgun in my car in the company lot?
expectedFacts: With a state concealed carry permit, firearms may be kept locked inside a personal vehicle on company property per Ohio law
Weapons are prohibited inside the company building and client sites with no exceptions
expectedSections: Basic Responsibilities and Duties of all Employees

question: A bank called asking to verify a former coworker's employment. What do I do?
expectedFacts: All inquiries about current or former employees go to the Director, Operations
Only name, dates of employment and job title are verified
expectedSections: Basic Responsibilities and Duties of all Employees

question: What's the max value of a gift I can accept from a vendor?
expectedFacts: Employees may not accept gifts worth more than $50 from clients, suppliers or competitors
expectedSections: Conflict of Interest and Outside Employment Policy

question: how much is the travel bonus per night and when does it kick in
expectedFacts: The travel bonus is $40 per night
It is paid once 12 nights in a quarter has been exceeded
It applies to billable work and is on top of per diem

question: What are the meal limits when I'm traveling for a client?
expectedFacts: Up to $10 for breakfast, $15 for lunch and $25 for dinner
Up to $50 per day total
Exceptions may apply for expensive locations or client meals

question: How much will they reimburse for parking at a client site each month?
expectedFacts: Up to $140 per month
Only if free parking is not available

question: What's the most I can get as an emergency pay advance?
expectedFacts: The maximum emergency pay advance is $1,000
It must be repaid in no more than three equal monthly payroll deductions
Requests go in writing to HR and Finance and approval is at leadership's discretion

question: How long is the sabbatical and is there a stipend?
expectedFacts: Option 1 is 4 weeks of PTO without utilization impact
Option 2 is 2 weeks of PTO plus a $5,000 stipend
Requires at least 5 qualifying years of service

question: How much will Ingage match on my charitable donations?
expectedFacts: Up to $500 per year for salaried employees
Up to $250 per year for hourly employees
Donations must go to qualified 501(c)(3) nonprofits

question: How many PTO hours can roll over into next year?
expectedFacts: Unused PTO above 40 hours does not carry over
Unused PTO is not paid out at year end or termination

question: If I bring in a new client what's the commission?
expectedFacts: 2% of billable revenue from the new client
Paid for the first 6 months
There is no cap on the amount

question: What's the ESOP vesting schedule?
expectedFacts: 0% vested under 2 years, 20% at 2 years
Vesting rises 20% per year: 40% at 3, 60% at 4, 80% at 5
Fully vested (100%) at 6 years

question: how much learning money do i get per year for courses and stuff
expectedFacts: The growth and learning budget is up to $1,500/year for salaried and $500/year for hourly employees
Manager/Coach approval is required to use it
The allocation is prorated by hire date

question: Do I get paid if I volunteer at my kid's school?
expectedFacts: Yes, school activities qualify for paid volunteer time (PVTO)
PVTO pays $50 per hour
Up to 4 hours per month can be earned

question: Will the company pay for my yoga classes?
expectedFacts: Wellness classes are eligible for wellness reimbursement

Submit through regular expense reporting

question: thinking about quitting, how much heads up do I have to give?
expectedFacts: The company asks for two weeks' written notice
PTO may not be included in the two-week notice period
expectedSections: Discipline & Leaving Revision Collective and its Operating Companies

question: Can I put some company money toward my student loans?
expectedFacts: Up to 50% of the growth and learning budget can repay past student loan debt

question: How do I get paid back for gas when I drive to a client that's far away?
expectedFacts: Mileage is reimbursed at the IRS rate for non-local client sites
Round trip mileage minus 70 miles per day is reimbursable
Prior approval is required and the reimbursement is taxed

question: If I get a friend hired here do I get anything for it?
expectedFacts: A $1,000 referral bonus (or $500 for a lead) is offered for client billing roles Consultant and above
Paid after the person completes 3 months (480 hours) of client billable work

question: what happens to my health insurance after I leave the company
expectedFacts: Former plan participants can continue coverage under COBRA, usually for 18 months
The former employee pays the full premium plus a 2% admin fee
COBRA is not available to those terminated for gross misconduct

question: I'm an hourly consultant and got a jury summons. Do I get paid?
expectedFacts: Hourly employees get unpaid leave for jury duty, while salaried employees get the difference between jury pay and salary
Hourly employees subpoenaed as a witness in a company-related matter get their regular rate minus witness fees
Answer should point the asker to HR or their Manager/Coach to confirm their case

question: I'm in the Thrive apprentice program, can I sign up for the 401k?
expectedFacts: Apprentices are not eligible for the 401(k), ESOP or profit sharing

question: I'm part-time at about 60%. How much paid parental leave would I get?
expectedFacts: Paid portions of parental leave are prorated by part-time percentage, e.g., 60% gets 1.2 of the 2 fully paid weeks

question: I've only been here 8 months and I'm pregnant — do I qualify for maternity leave?
expectedFacts: Paid maternity leave is for salaried employees after one year of service
FMLA also requires one year of service
Answer should point the asker to HR or their Manager/Coach to discuss options

question: how much PTO do I get?
expectedFacts: PTO depends on title: apprentices get 3 weeks, home office managers 4 weeks, non-billing directors 5 weeks
Consulting staff PTO is based on utilization

question: I've been part-time salaried for 5 years at around 40%. Am I eligible for a sabbatical?
expectedFacts: Sabbatical is for salaried employees working 50% to full-time
